brief: A high Himālayan slope with snow peaks and dark pines: the thin young man seated cross-legged on a flat rock beside a tiny fire, eyes closed in austerity, snow on his shoulders; above him on the peak a serene ascetic figure with a thin crescent moon in his matted hair, hand raised in blessing; drifting cloud; soft gold light.
